summary: community.aws in Ansible 11 drops botocore<1.31.0 and boto3<1.28.0. Modules such as autoscaling_instance_refresh(_info), ec2_launch_template and ec2_placement_group moved to amazon.aws. ec2_launch_template tags now apply to the template itself, not the resources it launches.
questions: Why are my ec2_launch_template tags not on the instances anymore?
What's the new FQCN for ec2_launch_template?

answer_card.title: community.aws migrations in Ansible 11
answer_card.answer_md:
- Minimum SDK: `botocore>=1.31.0`, `boto3>=1.28.0`.
- Moved to amazon.aws, so update FQCNs: `autoscaling_instance_refresh`, `autoscaling_instance_refresh_info`, `ec2_launch_template`, `ec2_placement_group`, `ec2_placement_group_info`.
- `ec2_launch_template`: `tags` now tag the **launch template resource**, not the resources created from it.
